entities.name: Quantum Mechanics
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The fundamental theory describing nature at the atomic and subatomic scale, where particles exhibit wave-particle duality and measurement affects outcomes. Developed by Planck, Bohr, Heisenberg, Schrödinger, and Dirac (1900–1930), quantum mechanics enabled transistors, lasers, MRI, and the entire digital revolution.
